headline: Midwestern State stand alone without a defeat
dek: Midwestern State have won eleven and drawn four without losing, and Saturday's draw at West Texas A&M was their fourth. Jake Morris has kept five clean sheets in goal, and the side have conceded 12 goals all season.
displaced_by: Sul Ross State have now scored, so the standing headline is no longer true; Midwestern State, the only side yet to lose, take the lede.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Ten different players have scored Midwestern State's 40 goals, and Parker Plaxco has twelve of them.

wire.line: Sul Ross State have scored twice in thirteen matches and lost every one of them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Five matches are past their date with no result published: Lubbock Christian's against Western Texas, Southwest and Hardin-Simmons, St. Edward's against Southwestern, and Oklahoma Christian's against Oklahoma Panhandle State.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: UT Dallas have lost twice, against eight wins and five draws, and conceded 11 goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Fernando Hernandez has made 63 saves for Sul Ross State.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Jose Ortiz has scored seven goals for Midwestern State.

last_match.line: Oklahoma Christian are still unbeaten in conference play; it was St. Mary's first conference defeat.

next_match.line: Midwestern State have yet to lose this season; only Sul Ross State have lost more matches than Lubbock Christian.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
